obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: Direct deployment of the same exact endpoint creation code is also a fresh supported construction. The factory is not a deployment receipt.

obligations.abstractCondition: Every actual balance callback materialises min(owned frozen target, actual balance) before the token operation returns.
obligations.compiledConsumer: Actual T-REX transfer, transferFrom, batch transfer and forced-transfer callbacks execute the HookAdapter runtime.
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: This is evidence for the pinned T-REX callback order and fixed profile. It is not a claim about every ERC-3643 implementation.

obligations.abstractCondition: Only the immutable Compliance bound to the token may invoke the balance-change callback.
obligations.normativeReceiver: The hook cannot be an unauthenticated state-changing entrypoint.

obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: The callback can only move upstream frozen amounts toward adapter-owned targets; it cannot create a TRUST command.

obligations.abstractCondition: A failed post-balance callback reverts the token balance, allowance and emitted effects in the same transaction.
obligations.normativeReceiver: Failure during same-transaction enforcement cannot leave a partial transfer.
obligations.finalSourceConsumer: Pinned T-REX transferFrom calls Compliance after its tentative balance update; EVM reversion restores the call frame.
obligations.consumerRemovalNegative: The test injects the failing callback and requires exact balance and allowance stutter before a successful recovery transfer.
obligations.compiledConsumer: Actual T-REX 4.1.3 bytecode under the CANCUN execution schedule
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: Correct EVM transaction rollback under the named schedule remains in the trusted execution semantics.

obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: The receipt commits to the observed value. It does not prove the external legal truth of that restriction.
